rooms.question: Can two different settings produce the same result?
rooms.ontology: QFEP is the project’s exploratory organising model: QFE=F−λE+φΔE. In this console the four terms are adjustable numbers, not independently measured physicalquantities.
rooms.action: Move onlyF and watch theresult. Restore it, moveE, and then try compensating withF until the numericalresult is close to whereitstarted.
rooms.observable: The readout and four-axis polygon change. Differentpolygon shapes can give the sameQFE; colour/category can shift as the setting approaches a different authoredsignature.
rooms.mechanism: Four0–1sliders feed the formula; ΔE is held at.30. A Manhattan-distance comparison chooses the nearest of7authored phase-signatures. It is not an emergentphase measurement.
rooms.limit: A single aggregate number loses distinctions between its inputs. These labels are theproject’s vocabulary for exploring tension, not a calibrated biological or thermodynamiclaw.
rooms.variation: Existing: find two unlike knobconfigurations with a similarQFE. Proposed: let thevisitor change the definition ofΔE and record why.
rooms.prior_bridge: Foundationscrisis questioned completeness; this laboratory makes its own chosenformula available for interrogation.
rooms.next_bridge: The nextroom starts with the predictability that a claim oforder relies on.
cautions: Source-reviewed draft; current museum reach, readable labels, controls and human learning unverified.

rooms.question: What makes the next mark easy to predict?
rooms.ontology: Binaryentropy measures average uncertainty for a Bernoulli source. The room uses predictability as a concrete entry to its idea oforder; that does notidentify Shannonentropy with the project’sFterm.
rooms.action: Move thep slider nearzero, through onehalf and nearone. Predict the nexttilecolour at eachsetting; compare the curve’smarker with thesamplegrid.
rooms.observable: Near eitherendpoint onecolour dominates andH islow. Atp=.5 the theoreticalcurve reaches1bit perdraw, while any finitesample can stilldepart from equalcounts.
rooms.mechanism: The bench thresholds a fixedseeded stream to generate a16×16sample and computes H(p)=−p log₂p−(1−p)log₂(1−p). Movingp changes bothprobability and thesample.
rooms.limit: Entropy describes a specifiedsource distribution. It is not the compressibility of everyparticular256bit picture, nor a measurement of beauty, value orfreeenergy.
rooms.variation: Existing: compare p=.1 withp=.9: oppositecolours but equal theoreticaluncertainty. Proposed: preserve localcorrelations while holding colourfrequency fixed to expose what a Bernoullimodel omits.
rooms.prior_bridge: The console combined quantities; thisroom asks what one explicitnotion oforder can actuallymeasure.
rooms.next_bridge: Possibilityspace next distinguishes one realisedoutcome from the number ofavailableoutcomes.
cautions: Source-reviewed draft; current museum reach, readable labels, controls and human learning unverified.
F/freeenergy is not directlymeasured. Avoid universal finite-file compressionbound implied by legacycaption. snap_cube_puzzle registryactually resolves to octahedronpuzzle; not selectedcore.

Central concept gap: selected workbench computes Shannon entropy H(p), not F. Draft gives a predictor comparison as a thought experiment and proposes an actual expectation/error readout; do not treat H, prediction error and variational free energy as identical.

rooms.question: How many endings remain possible before one is chosen?
rooms.ontology: A possibilitycount W describes the allowedoutcomes of a chosenmodel. For equallyweighted possibilities, logW measures their multiplicity; unequalprobabilities need a weightedentropy.
rooms.action: Watch the fan narrow to asinglepath and open into branches. Count the firstforks, predict theleafcount, then compare with the FUTURESreadout.
rooms.observable: The default9secondcycle changes branching between1,2and3 across4levels, giving1,16or81leaves. The displayedS follows the naturallogarithm of actualleafcount.
rooms.mechanism: The tree is rebuilt onbranchchanges and increments a leafcounter. The readout useslog(max(leaves,1)); this is a countablecombinatorial diagram, not a gasmeasurement.
rooms.limit: Branches depict permittedfutures, not their likelihood orsocialaccessibility. An unbuiltbranch and an activelyclosedbranch require differentrecords even if they leave the samecount.
rooms.variation: Existing: attend to a singleend while the fanexpands. Proposed: expose the existing prunedconfiguration, which caps branches and leaves visible stumps, as a visitor-controlledcomparison.
rooms.prior_bridge: The binarybench measured uncertainty under aprobability; thefan makes the set ofpossible outcomes explicit.
rooms.next_bridge: Lambda nextasks how aweight mediates between anorderclaim and thepossibilities leftopen.
cautions: Source-reviewed draft; current museum reach, readable labels, controls and human learning unverified.

rooms.question: Where does this corridor tell you to stand between stillness and motion?
rooms.ontology: Lambda is a weightingparameter in theprojectmodel. The hall maps lateralposition to a continuum between two authoredforms oforder anddispersal.
rooms.action: Look left toward the regularwall and right toward the displacedmoving forms. Locate the litwalkway and compare the rows between theextremes.
rooms.observable: The westwall repeats a lattice, the eastwall breaks it into animatedforms, and sixrows interpolate between them. The litband is placed at the authoredlambda=.35.
rooms.mechanism: The script builds these structures directly frompositional fractions; walkway x=−halfwidth+lambda×width. It does not measure a phase transition or calculate an optimalplace forlife.
rooms.limit: The litroute makes one choice inviting. That choice is a spatialargument by theproject; the displayed.35 is not a universalcriticalpoint or an empiricaldefinition oflife.
rooms.variation: Existing: inspect the regularside as shelter or the dispersedside as room forvariation instead of accepting the paintedmiddle asbest. Proposed: move thelitband and compare the invitation.
rooms.prior_bridge: The fan counted possiblefutures; the hall shows how a spatialpresentation canprivilege one region.
rooms.next_bridge: Phi nextseparates where a system is from how it responds tochange.
cautions: Source-reviewed draft; current museum reach, readable labels, controls and human learning unverified.
Do notpromise walkway reach untilmuseumwalk;14×7m artifact mayneedfit. No lifeatlambda.35claim.

rooms.question: Can change have a direction without one direction being intrinsically better?
rooms.ontology: Phi weights thechange term in theprojectformula. Its signedscale is a modelchoice; the neighbouringpattern is an independent illustration of distributedchange.
rooms.action: Move thePHI handle throughzero and compare its own particlefeedback andcolour. Then watch two differentcells in the transformingpattern and compare theirphases.
rooms.observable: Negativephi directs the slider’s particlesdown; positivephi directs themup. Thegold gridcontinues its wave-drivenmotion independently of theslider.
rooms.mechanism: The XRhandle maps railposition to[-1,1]. Thegrid combines prescribedwaves into height,scale andcolour; it does not subscribe to phi. These are two adjacentrepresentations, not a causallylinkedcontrol andsimulation.
rooms.limit: Upwardgold and downwardpurple colour the valuejudgement before anyargument. Welcomingchange may matter, but preservation can also protect what dominantdefinitions erase.
rooms.variation: Existing: dwell at neutral ornegativephi and name a kindofchange worthresisting. Proposed: connectphi to a measurabletemporal response and compare with a preservedpattern.
rooms.prior_bridge: Lambda weighted onebalance; phi introduces thequestion of howchange isvalued.
rooms.next_bridge: The nextroom gives a control thatactually alters a patternformingprocess.
cautions: Source-reviewed draft; current museum reach, readable labels, controls and human learning unverified.

rooms.question: Which changes belong to the pattern, and which to the way we drive it?
rooms.ontology: This artifact is a two-concentration reaction-diffusion model. Lambda jointly changes feed,kill anddiffusion constants along one authoredpath through itsparameters.
rooms.action: Move LAMBDA slowly, wait for the patternresponse, and use RESEED tocompare a newstart. Keep SIM SPEEDfixed while comparing lambda.
rooms.observable: A colouredconcentration image changes as reactions andneighbourdiffusion evolve. ChangingLAMBDA affects severalcoefficients atonce; SIM SPEED changes the numberofupdates perframe.
rooms.mechanism: The64×64Grid applies Gray-Scottstyle reactionterms with periodicneighbours. Feed rises.01→.08,kill falls.08→.03; bothdiffusions alsorise. Defaultunlocked controluses thelegacystep; frozen/chaospreset tenures use a separatestable step.
rooms.limit: A patternlabel is not evidence ofuniversalcriticality. Numericaltimestep, initialconditions and thechosenparameterpath all affectthepicture; apparentactivity can be discretisationartifact.
rooms.variation: Existing: compare persistence beforeandafterRESEED at the samesliderposition. Proposed: a fixed-timestepcomparison and a measuredpatternstatistic acrosslambda.
rooms.prior_bridge: Phi’sscale revealed avaluedirection; now test acontrol against aresponse that isactuallycomputed.
rooms.next_bridge: The sandbox asks which nearbyobjects genuinelyrespond to acommoncontrol.
cautions: Source-reviewed draft; current museum reach, readable labels, controls and human learning unverified.
Numericalstability gap: defaultunlocked stilluses legacydt1 integrator; do notclaim empiricallyestablished edge/chaosregimes fromdefaultpicture.

rooms.question: How do we tell a control that changes a number from one that changes a system?
rooms.ontology: A control, parameter and response form a causalchain only when the receiving system uses the newvalue. Shared vocabulary and proximity do not establish thatconnection.
rooms.action: Move onehandle at atime, record its own printedvalue/colour, and compare the localfeedback ofLAMBDA with PHI. Keep the otherhandle fixed.
rooms.observable: LAMBDA reads0–1 and changes itslocalcolour/feedback; PHI reads−1–1 and reverses itslocalparticle direction acrosszero. The nearbyreactor/particlefield are not proven totrack eithercontrol.
rooms.mechanism: Sliders join qfep_lambda_controllers and qfep_phi_controllers; the reactorandfield search the different qfep_slidergroup. No bridge isbound in theinspectedmap/scene.
rooms.limit: The intended coupled sandbox has a wiringgap. A correctprinted setting alone cannotdemonstrate a change in a distantartifact or let thisroom certify theformula.
rooms.variation: Proposed nextbuild: explicitlywire bothcontrols to one scopedreceiver, expose receivedvalues and compare oneparameter at atime. Presentcontrolobservations are a startingpoint, not fulfilment ofthatexperiment.
rooms.prior_bridge: The reaction-diffusionpiece supplied aconnectedlocalcontrol; the sandbox intends toextend thatrelation acrosspieces.
rooms.next_bridge: The specimen in thesynthesis has its own locallyconnectedcontrols for a more concretecomparison.
cautions: Source-reviewed draft; current museum reach, readable labels, controls and human learning unverified.
Centralencountergap: wire room-scopedcoupling; do not turnbug into intendedphilosophicalargument. Book should plainly mark intendednext experiment rather than assert success.

rooms.question: Which kind of stability are you asking this body to keep?
rooms.ontology: The specimen interprets two projectparameters through softbodyproperties: lambdaaffects stiffness/pressure; phiaffects damping/drag. These are authoredmappings between vocabulary andmechanics.
rooms.action: Use the specimen’s own LAMBDA andPHI sliders. Holdone fixed while movingtheother; compare how shape,motion andreadoutrespond.
rooms.observable: Lambda shifts stiffness andcolour whilephi shifts thedampinganddrag of thespecimen. Namedstates onthelabel are assignedfrom parameterbands.
rooms.mechanism: Stiffness lerps.9→.1 withlambda; pressure peaksbydesign at.5. Phi[-1,1] maps damping.2→.001 anddrag.3→0. Breathing is also timed. Mapscale.25 makes itsbuiltcontrols notablysmall.
rooms.limit: A visiblebodyresponding to mechanics is not an assay ofqueerness or alivingstate. The sameword phi had a differentscale on the firstconsole; consistentmeaning requires naming eachmapping.
rooms.variation: Existing: combine highstiffness with lowdamping, or lowstiffness with highdamping, instead ofchoosing only namedpresets. Proposed: keep one measurabledeformation trace as acomparison.
rooms.prior_bridge: The sandboxneeds a sharedconnection; this specimen closes a smallerlocal loop between two controls andonebody.
rooms.next_bridge: Post-crisis asks how an explicitlylimited model can still support accountableaction.
